نسلنقي (form IIIq)
# نَسْلَنْقِي (naslanqī) /nas.lan.qiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْلَنْقَى (islanqā)
# نَسْلَنْقِيَ (naslanqiya) /nas.lan.qi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْلَنْقَى (islanqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
